long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I will take flowers from the meadow without asking, which is how I like to get things.
I will plant the flowers in the garden to see whether anything unknown grows from them.
Seeds that grow without anyone's permission are worth reading about, and I am not yet done with them.
Reading has tired me, and a patch of sun is the correct place to recover.
I will take one piece of the clay bank's wet orange clay, since clay is good and I mean to keep something made from it.
At the workbench one piece of clay can become a small bowl worth keeping where I can see it.
From a high place I can see everything that has not yet been claimed by me.

today.reason: The day is for flowers, seeds and clay, with a long nap in the sun and a high place to watch from, all of it on my own terms.
